newsitem.title: FRANCE: French express firm, Chronopost moves to new HQ.
newsitem.headline: French express firm, Chronopost moves to new HQ.

text.p: French express distribution operator, Chronopost S.A., said it had moved into new purpose-built head office at Issy-le Moulineaux in the Paris suburbs.
Situated a short distance from Chronopost's previous head office, the seven storey building covers an area of 5,100 square metres, a Chronopost official told Reuters.
Unlike the former HQ, which it occupied as a tenant, Chronopost owns the new building. The official said he could not disclose the cost involved in the new building.
Chronopost plans to open a further five French depots between now and the end of 1996 taking its nationwide network to 36, but their location is not yet available.
Chronopost is 66 percent-owned by the French post office and 34 percent by French aviation holdings group, TAT SA. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
